note: First election of the rural district council (the twelve Co. Armagh divisions of Newry union, two councillors each), polled 6 April 1899. The divisions without a contest are marked in the nomination list, which gives no party labels; electorates as printed there. Returned unopposed. Felix M'Parland: no party label printed in 1899. At other elections he stood as Nationalist (Newtownhamilton, Armagh County Council, 28 May 1902, printed 'N.': Banbridge Chronicle, 31 May 1902, p. 3 ("Local Government Elections": Armagh County Council); nominations and labels also in the Armagh Guardian, 2 May 1902, p. 2 ("But Few Contests": county council nominations, with labels)).
